test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the (bracketed) part of the sentence. In case of no improvement select the option 'No improvement'.

There's even a (picture by which a witch is riding) a broomstick on the sides of the police cars.

options.text: picture that of a witch riding

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Picture of a witch riding'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** original sentence** is grammatically **incorrect** because the phrase "picture by which a witch is riding" is not idiomatic and does not convey the intended meaning clearly.
 
• **Option 3 corrects **this by using the phrase "picture of a witch riding."
 
• **This phrase** is more concise and effectively conveys that the picture depicts a witch riding a broomstick.
 
• **It maintains the intended meaning **of the sentence in a clearer and more grammatically correct way.
 
• However, in option 2, 'pictures' is wrong because it is a plural noun & in the sentence after the article 'a' we will use a singular noun i.e. Picture.
 
• In option 4, the use of the conjunction 'that' is incorrect as per the grammatical context of the sentence.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *There's even a **picture of a witch riding **a broomstick on the sides of the police cars.*
